name: Liquid Corner
approach: Park as for 'Little Russia' and ice climbs End of the Line and Lovely Parting Gifts. Hike up the ridge on the North side of Peskett Canyon Drainage.
notes: A long corner system about 200m right of the canyon entrance. Developed in 2020.

name: AA
approach: Park as for 'Little Russia' and ice climbs End of the Line and Lovely Parting Gifts. Hike up the ridge on the North side of Peskett Canyon Drainage.
notes: Adventurous multi-pitch line on the Solar Panel. Developed in 2020.

name: Energizer Bunny
approach: Park as for 'Little Russia' and ice climbs End of the Line and Lovely Parting Gifts. Follow yellow flagging tape for 20 minutes to the creek.
notes: Starts 50m lower than Batteries Not Included. Developed in 2020.

name: Voltzwagen
approach: Park as for 'Little Russia' and ice climbs End of the Line and Lovely Parting Gifts. Hike up the ridge on the North side of Peskett Canyon Drainage.
notes: Start up and right of Batteries Not Included. Developed in 2020.

name: Batteries Not Included - Pitch 1
approach: Park as for 'Little Russia', hike up the North side of Peskett Canyon Drainage following yellow flagging tape to Mt. Elliot creek.
notes: Scramble up to the top of the pinnacle clipping two bolts to a chain station.

name: Batteries Not Included - Pitch 2
approach: Park as for 'Little Russia'.
notes: Stay under bolts and trend left to gain a groove.

name: Batteries Not Included - Pitch 3
approach: Park as for 'Little Russia'.
notes: Up and trend left through a small choss band into the groove.

name: Batteries Not Included - Pitch 4
approach: Park as for 'Little Russia'.
notes: Follow the weakness to a bolted station.

name: Batteries Not Included - Pitch 5
approach: Park as for 'Little Russia'.
notes: Fun traverse left through a balancy crux.

name: Batteries Not Included - Pitch 6
approach: Park as for 'Little Russia'.
notes: Climb straight up to a large treed ledge with a bolted station.

name: Batteries Not Included - Pitch 7
approach: Park as for 'Little Russia'.
notes: Climb up and left with hidden first bolt; slab gradually gets harder.

name: Batteries Not Included - Pitch 8
approach: Park as for 'Little Russia'.
notes: Straightforward slab through loose rock to a station in the yellow bay.

name: Batteries Not Included - Pitch 9
approach: Park as for 'Little Russia'.
notes: Exposed traverse left, clip a bolt, commit to hard moves through the crux.

name: Zardoz - Pitch 1
approach: Park in pullout 7.4km from Cline River Bridge. Walk back ~100m, cross creek, follow trail up bluff on South side.
notes: Clip first bolt and pull an awkward move on short slab.

name: Zardoz - Pitch 2
approach: Park in big pullout 7.4km from Cline River Bridge.
notes: Climb up and right on wall above waterfall, pull rotten flake.

name: Zardoz - Pitch 3
approach: Park in big pullout 7.4km from Cline River Bridge.
notes: Move your belay station left to a big warm ledge.

name: Zardoz - Pitch 4
approach: Park in big pullout 7.4km from Cline River Bridge.
notes: Technical face climbing on razor-sharp limestone.

name: Zardoz - Pitch 5
approach: Park in big pullout 7.4km from Cline River Bridge.
notes: All points off jug-to-jug dyno under the overhang.

name: Zardoz - Pitch 6
approach: Park in big pullout 7.4km from Cline River Bridge.
notes: Climb face to little ledge, pull through steep face onto positive wall.

name: Star Struck - Pitch 1
approach: ~500m east of 'From Nordegg With Love' via ferrata. Hike across base and gain ridge buttress.
notes: Start up broken rock, pull bulge, follow bolts left to ledge.

name: Star Struck - Pitch 2
approach: ~500m east of 'From Nordegg With Love' via ferrata.
notes: Follow bolts trending left to a ledge under two small bulges.

name: Star Struck - Pitch 3
approach: ~500m east of 'From Nordegg With Love' via ferrata.
notes: Pull first crux bulge and trend left to second crux bulge on amazing rock.

name: Star Struck - Pitch 4
approach: ~500m east of 'From Nordegg With Love' via ferrata.
notes: Follow bolts trending left on prickly rock.

name: Star Struck - Pitch 5
approach: ~500m east of 'From Nordegg With Love' via ferrata.
notes: Sparse bolts up easier terrain to slanting ledge.

name: Star Struck - Pitch 6
approach: ~500m east of 'From Nordegg With Love' via ferrata.
notes: Head up trending right to a ledge.

name: Star Struck - Pitch 7
approach: ~500m east of 'From Nordegg With Love' via ferrata.
notes: Head left clipping bolts with a 3-finger pocket crux.

name: Star Struck - Pitch 8
approach: ~500m east of 'From Nordegg With Love' via ferrata.
notes: Head up clipping bolts on good rock to a nice ledge.

name: Star Struck - Pitch 9
approach: ~500m east of 'From Nordegg With Love' via ferrata.
notes: Head out left clipping a bolt, walk across slope to waterfall base tree.

name: Star Struck - Pitch 10
approach: ~500m east of 'From Nordegg With Love' via ferrata.
notes: Climb right side of waterfall, cross it just below the lip.

name: Dumbo - Pitch 1
approach: Park at Windy Point, cross Highway 11 at Lookout Slabs and follow red flagging tape up.
notes: Textured slab following bolts trending left to a ledge.

name: Dumbo - Pitch 2
approach: Park at Windy Point, cross Highway 11 at Lookout Slabs.
notes: Fun flat 'elephant ear' scoop feature with lie-back style.

name: Dumbo - Pitch 3
approach: Park at Windy Point, cross Highway 11 at Lookout Slabs.
notes: Go left off the belay past a short bulge over a cruisey slab.

name: Dumbo - Pitch 4
approach: Park at Windy Point, cross Highway 11 at Lookout Slabs.
notes: Cruise black and white water runnels on juggy terrain.

name: Wet Like Willy - Pitch 1
approach: Park at Windy Point, cross Highway 11 at Lookout Slabs and follow red flagging tape left.
notes: Textured slab following bolts.

name: Wet Like Willy - Pitch 2
approach: Park at Windy Point, cross Highway 11 at Lookout Slabs.
notes: Move up and right to gain runnel for 10m, follow bolts left.

name: Wet Like Willy - Pitch 3
approach: Park at Windy Point, cross Highway 11 at Lookout Slabs.
notes: Traverse right without gaining elevation to top station.

name: Susan's Pollution Solution - Pitch 2
approach: Park at Windy Point, cross Highway 11 at Lookout Slabs.

name: Susan's Pollution Solution - Pitch 3
approach: Park at Windy Point, cross Highway 11 at Lookout Slabs.
notes: Easier ground to an awkward belay stance.

name: Kuzco's Poison - Pitch 3

approach: Abraham Slabs on Mt. Abraham.
